  - cert: pca

check:
  kind: range
  prompt: Paste the p95 latency in seconds.
  min: 0.1
  max: 0.5
---

<Why>
A measured number is never exactly the same twice, so an exact answer would fail a learner who did everything right. A range check accepts any value inside honest bounds.
</Why>

<Idea>
The pasted number must be between the minimum and the maximum, both included.
</Idea>

<Do>
1. Run the query and paste the number it returns.
</Do>

<Done>
The check says passed.
</Done>

<Question id="q-m90-s04" answer="d">
What does a range check accept?

- Only the exact expected number

  That would fail a correct but slightly different reading.

- Any text

  It wants a number.

- Any number

  It wants a number inside the bounds.

- A number between the bounds

  Right: both bounds are included.
</Question>
